references.title: Selling Without Being Salesy
references.creator: The Futur; design credited in indexed portfolio to Breno Monteiro / Tasca Studios
references.format: Designer portfolio showing a video-thumbnail design
references.lesson: Two portrait anchors flank a compact white/yellow phrase on a dark ground. Study the separation of a human focal point and one readable phrase, not the two-person formula.
references.application: Use one authentic Bibek portrait and one buyer question; the title names LotusMala and the blueprint.
references.avoid: Do not add a second person, copy the composition literally, use their faces, or imply this episode teaches sales closing.
references.review: Indexed image preview and direct image opened; portfolio page returned 403. Designer credit is indexed attribution, not independently confirmed from the full project page.

references.title: Building a Marketing Strategy in 10 Minutes?
references.creator: Neil Patel
references.lesson: A presenter, a strongly contrasting background and one explicit marketing question make the subject identifiable. The headline is longer than Bibek needs: retain the hierarchy, shorten the copy.
references.application: Pair a neutral speaking frame with 'WHO IS THE BUYER?' and a title explaining the actual LotusMala exercise.
references.avoid: Do not borrow the ten-minute promise, speed challenge, circuitry, expert positioning, or revenue language.
references.review: Creator post and direct cover image opened; source post confirms the marketing-strategy premise. No thumbnail-specific performance data assessed.

references.title: Find Your Purpose - Ikigai Breakdown (Archive Series)
references.creator: The Futur / Chris Do
references.lesson: A real board and a large topic word act as visual evidence of a concrete explanation. The physical artifact gives context without requiring a paragraph of overlay text.
references.application: Keep an authentic 'Buyer Persona' or 'CTA' board detail large; add at most a short 'BUYER → CTA' or '6 STEPS' label.
references.avoid: Do not copy the Ikigai content, diagrams, pointing gesture, expertise claim, or career-outcome promise.
references.review: Official source page opened and indexed thumbnail preview reviewed. Direct YouTube CDN requests were throttled/inaccessible; no full-resolution or 160×90 pixel review claimed.

references.title: SEO Course for Beginners
references.creator: Ahrefs / Sam Oh
references.format: Official course-cover reference, adjacent to YouTube thumbnails
references.lesson: The course is presented with a concrete topic and beginner scope. Its instructor/course presentation is a useful counterpoint to a vague motivational slogan; study simple topic hierarchy, not its brand system.
references.application: Name the actual framework or route from buyer to CTA. Treat six as the documented step count, not a promised result.
references.avoid: Do not imply this is an SEO course, a complete marketing certification, or a proven traffic strategy. Do not copy Ahrefs branding or blue palette automatically.
references.review: Official academy page and its linked cover image opened. Indexed course-page preview also checked. This is an adjacent course-cover reference, not a measured YouTube-thumbnail success example.

references.title: How to Start Your YouTube Channel with Ali Abdaal
references.creator: Skillshare / Ali Abdaal (attribution from indexed video preview)
references.format: Video-thumbnail preview for a creator-learning course
references.lesson: An ordinary seated presenter, a coherent room and plain topic text communicate a human learning context without artificial emotion. The useful principle is readable subject-plus-context.
references.application: Use Bibek's real speaking portrait with 'MY COURSE PROJECT'; let the title identify the LotusMala marketing plan.
references.avoid: Do not borrow the Skillshare logo, Ali's face/studio, or a 'how to' authority promise when the episode documents Bibek's own exercise.
references.review: Indexed image preview checked twice. Direct video/CDN requests failed or were rate-limited; original upload metadata was not independently fetched. Attribution remains preview-level.

references.title: Ali Abdaal - The Four Principles Of Learning Anything
references.creator: Ali Abdaal as guest; mirror attributed to Chris Williamson
references.format: Learning-video cover preview; provisional secondary/mirror source
references.lesson: A presenter with real books creates tangible learning context. A physical project artifact can make a portrait meaningful; it need not be a dramatic facial reaction.
references.application: Use Bibek's actual whiteboard as the learning artifact, not invented certificates, course dashboards or achievement props.
references.avoid: Do not import the four-principle framework, use books/certificates absent from the footage, or imply proven learning results.
references.review: Direct cover image opened; mirror page timed out and original YouTube upload could not be fetched. Keep as a provisional composition reference, not an authoritative source for rights, channel attribution or performance.

references.title: Positioning & Lead Generation
references.creator: The Futur / Chris Do
references.lesson: A short topic name can carry an educational cover without a face. Study concise hierarchy and deliberate negative space; this is an alternative when no authentic face frame is strong enough.
references.application: If the clean portrait remains weak, favor a genuine board detail plus a short project label instead of generating a new expression.
references.avoid: Do not copy the neon grid, distinctive graphic mark, branding or service-pricing promise. Do not present Bibek as selling this course.
references.review: Official course page opened; indexed cover preview reviewed. Direct asset URL failed. Adjacent course-cover reference only; no conversion or CTR evidence.
